summary: hash filter parameters: required input and hashtype (default sha1), whose choices depend on the installed Python hashlib.
questions: How do I choose the algorithm for the hash filter?
Which hash algorithms can I use with the hash filter?

answer_card.title: hash filter parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (raw, required): data to hash
- `hashtype` (default `sha1`): algorithm to use. Available choices depend on the installed Python's `hashlib`.
